capabilities: replace a highlighted issue tag with a link to the Azure DevOps web issue
link issues to a local file, creating it if missing
configure multiple Azure DevOps instances with a default
map projects to abbreviations and set a local issue root folder
extras: The README references a demo section that is not included in the text; local issue paths are limited to a single configured folder.
problem: Turning Azure DevOps issue identifiers into working URLs or local notes requires manually constructing links each time.
summary: Formats highlighted Azure DevOps issue tags as links to the web issue on your instance or to a local file in the vault.
